name: sol-advisor
description: Haru fork of Sol Advisor with a High-default primary effort preflight and Luna-first model-pinned execution roles.

interface.shortDescription: Sol starts High, gates Medium vs High pre-tool, then uses Luna-first execution.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor starts GPT-6.1 Sol / High by default and performs a tool-free primary-effort gate before substantive work. Bounded low-to-moderate-risk tasks are redirected to a fresh GPT-6.1 Sol / Medium task rather than changing effort in-session. After the primary effort matches, GPT-6.1 Sol owns architecture, decomposition, integration, escalation, and final acceptance while GPT-6 Luna / Max explorer, worker, tester, and researcher roles handle non-trivial routine execution by default. GPT-5.6 Terra / High is reserved for judgment-heavy implementation exceptions, and fresh GPT-6.1 Sol / High review is reserved for high-risk final scrutiny. All auxiliary roles keep explicit model pins, fork_turns: none, runtime evidence checks, and fail-closed installation.
defaultPrompt: Use $sol-advisor:orchestration to run the PRIMARY EFFORT gate before task tools. Start from Sol / High by default; if the task is medium-recommended, stop and restart it as a fresh Sol / Medium task instead of switching effort in-session.

After the primary effort matches, declare the SELECTIVE ROUTE; keep architecture and final acceptance in Sol and use Luna-first explorer, worker, tester, and researcher roles for routine execution. Reserve Terra and fresh Sol review for explicit exception cases.
